decisions.reason: As a 2024-launched product line with several models that builds directly on the firm's core precast equipment business, it appears strategically committed yet still early enough that management would keep the option open unless market feedback turns clearly negative.

Because the production analysis software is a close complement to the firm's automation, controls, and service offering and is relatively inexpensive to keep available while demand uncertainty resolves, real-options logic favors retaining it for another year.
